description: Lists the keywords tracked by ONE rank tracker: `{ keywords, totalCount, page, pageSize }`, each row `{ id, configId, keyword, searchVolume, keywordDifficulty, cpc, metricsFetchedAt, createdAt }`. It returns NO positions and runs no check — read positions with get_rank_tracker. The row `id` is the tracking-keyword ID that remove_rank_tracking_keywords, update_rank_keyword_tag and set_rank_keyword_target_url take. FREE: database only.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: list_rank_tracking_keywords
